desc: With HSM Ammo’s Tipping Point2, hunters get less drag, greater stability, and superior accuracy. Tipping Point 2 ammunition is deadly accurate and capable of creating a substantial wound channel. Add that to the promised accuracy of this ammo and you have the perfect recipe for a fantastic hunt. This ammunition is made from quality materials with strict attention to detail and high expectations for consistent, superior overall performance. Match grade accuracy combined with a payoff of extreme terminal results. The very best cases, primers, and powder, topped off with the Hornady SST bullets. An extraordinary cartridge providing an ultimate advantage. This ammunition is new production, non-corrosive, in boxer-primed, reloadable brass cases.
